description: List the forex currency pairs with rates, in pair order: pair (EUR/USD), both currencies' names, whether it still trades and its first stored trade date. A rate is the price of one unit of the first currency in the second, from one exchange's trades, not an interbank or official reference rate. currency keeps the pairs that include it. Use GetForexQuote for the latest rate, GetForexPrices for daily candles and GetForexIntradayPrices for candles within the day. Included on every plan.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR, to keep the pairs that include it (default: every pair)

offset.description: Pairs to skip, for the next page (default: 0)

name: ListForexPairs
title: Forex Pairs
